headline: Rice, Wine…
summary: Party with paella, Pinot and other Carmel Valley wines at Carmel Valley Uncorked on Sunday, Oct. 11 from 3-6pm. Ten Carmel Valley wineries will be pouring and Jerome’s Carmel Valley Market will be dishing out the paella at Rancho Carmelo.
source: Monterey County Weekly / Monterey County NOW
